headline: Charitable food distribution staffing and solutions, plus police recruitment and a public safety policy framework.
summary: Committee action on charitable food distribution is expected, and public comment will be taken on it. Staff will also update the committee on winter warming shelters, Before & After the Bell registration, and police vacancies.
items: Charitable food distribution staffing and other solutions, with possible referral to Finance Committee for FY28 budget
Public safety improvement policy framework: taskforce sectors and facilitator
Before & After the Bell program registration process and 2027-2028 changes

Remote Meeting

Public comment will be taken on agenda Item #4 Charitable Food Distribution. To submit written public 
comment on an agenda item, email HHSPS@portlandmaine.gov. Submissions must be received by 12:00 pm 
the day before the Health & Human Services and Public Safety meeting to guarantee their inclusion in the 
agenda packet. All submissions must include the commenter's name and legal address. To help ensure your 
comment is submitted for the correct item, please include the name of the agenda item (see below). 
 
The Health & Human Services and Public Safety Committee will conduct this meeting remotely via Zoom 
pursuant to the Remote Meeting Policy adopted by the Portland City Council. Allow your computer to install 
the free Zoom app to get the best meeting experience. If you are not able to attend live either in person or via 
Zoom, a recording will be available in the Agenda Center following the meeting.

1. Announcements  
     
      
2. Review and Approval of Minutes from October 13, 2026  
     
      
  a. Draft Minutes 
      
3. Winter Warming Emergency Shelter Update (Maggie McLoughlin, Director HHS)  
  Staff will provide a monthly update on winter warming shelter information throughout the 
winter season. No public comment will be taken.    
      
4. Charitable Food Distribution (Greg Jordan, Assistant City Manager)  
  
Discussion on staffing and other solutions recommended to improve charitable food 
distribution. Committee will discuss funding implications and possible referral of 
recommendations to the Finance Committee for FY28 budget consideration. Committee 
action is anticipated and public comment will be taken.  
  
      
  a. Staff memo 
 
5. Public Safety Improvement Policy Framework (Greg Jordan, Assistant City Manager)  
  
Staff will present possible sectors for taskforce representation and facilitator, and seek 
input to refine the scope so a recommendation for the committee to consider advancing to 
the full council can be read for the next meeting. No public comment will be taken.  
  
      
6. Before & After the Bell Program Registration Process  
  
Staff will provide information about the registration process for this in-demand program, 
as well as changes planned for the 2027-2028 program year. No public comment will be 
taken.  
  
      
  a. Staff memo 
 
7. Police Department Recruitment (Mark DuBois, PD Chief)  
  Update on recruitment processes and status for police department vacancies. No public 
comment will be taken.    
      
8. Next Meeting: January 12, 2027
